title: Diet: Why Vegetarian
excerpt: Unfortunately, the government has no plan to tighten up regulation, and experts fear that antibiotic resistance will have to reach epidemic proportion
content:
Unfortunately, the government has no plan to tighten up regulation, and experts fear that antibiotic resistance will have to reach epidemic proportions before the government takes action.

(Dave Plank, Vegetarian times Feb. 1999)

Vol 18 Issue 2 Page 6
